title: The Soup Moon Rises
skyStory: The moon reaches first quarter, a neat half-lemon at thirty-five percent, and settles into Cancer, the crab who carries home on its back. Cancer wants everyone fed, warm, and accounted for. It has knitted a scarf for Mars. Mars is wearing it ironically. Saturn has been handed a ladle and is weirdly good at it.

reading: First quarter moons are decision points, and Cancer makes the decision about home. Today your best work happens at the cabin table, not out in the world.

Make the place nicer by one degree. Hang the picture that has leaned against the wall since autumn. Move the chair closer to the window. Light a candle at 6 pm even though it is still bright out. The [[Ten of Cups]] is drawing a rainbow over your roof, and it is a little crooked, like a kid made it. Fine. Crooked rainbows still count.
joel.mission: Fix, hang or move one thing at home that has bugged you since autumn, and admire it twice.
joel.omen: Smoke from a chimney drifting straight up. It means home is in balance, so stay in tonight.

reading: Cancer and Capricorn sit across from each other on the zodiac wheel, so tonight's moon is looking straight at you across the table. It wants to know: who looks after the one who looks after everyone?

The answer today is you. Make your own favourite warm thing, a drink, a blanket nest, a playlist of songs from the shore, and enjoy it without multitasking. When someone asks for help after 7 pm, say tomorrow, kindly. [[The Empress]] card is not in your spread, but she is here anyway, insisting you put your feet up. Mountains need rest days too.
nancy.mission: Spend twenty minutes doing something only for yourself, then tell no one about it. Keep it a secret treasure.
nancy.omen: A hermit crab or snail shell on a path or windowsill. It means your shell is allowed to be cozy today.

together.text: Describe your home to each other using only three smells. No pictures, no extra details. Then guess one thing in the other's kitchen right now. The crab moon is holding a wooden spoon and will judge accuracy with great tenderness.

game.intro: The soup moon rises, warm and sloshy. Three pairs, ten seconds. Spoons ready.
